arguments.content: P1 — Compatibility-reader removal during a bounded migration. A writer that emits only the new schema does not prove stored records have been migrated. Removing the old-shape read path while migration runs in batches makes a collection read fail when any unmigrated record remains. Retire compatibility reads only after an enforced migration-completion condition; validate the public read path on a mixed snapshot at zero, partial, and complete migration progress. Tests that only round-trip newly written records miss this rollout failure.
